## Carry Out & Delivery

## [Button: Do you deliver? ]

We offer delivery services through our online ordering, as well as through our Catering Department. You can view our catering menu online. For catering orders, please feel free to call 321-972-1888 or 1-855-368-7748 (ext 3).

VIEW OUR CATERING MENU

Delivery is also available through UberEats, BiteSquad, and DoorDash.

*Delivery service varies by location

## Our Food

## [Button: Is your sauce gluten-free? ]

Yes, our sauce is a gluten-free product. We do offer allergen information for all of our food, which is available here.

## [Button: Do you sell your BBQ sauces? ]

Yes, we do. Our sauces are available for purchase at all Smokehouse locations and online.

VIEW OUR ONLINE STORE

## [Button: Do you have nutritional information? ]

We do not have nutritional information for our menu items. We do however offer allergen information which is available through our menu.

VIEW OUR ALLERGEN MENU

## [Button: Do you have reheating instructions? ]

Yes, we do. A full list of reheating instructions is available through our menu.

VIEW OUR REHEATING INSTRUCTIONS

## Learn More About Allergens

Many of our products contain or may come into contact with common allergens, including wheat, peanuts, soy, tree nuts, milk, eggs, fish, shellfish and sesame.

 

Our bakery-cafe and catering menus vary by location due to, among other things, market tests and local requirements. If you have an allergy concern, please ask a manager at your bakery-cafe to check the ingredient listing for specific menu items. Please note that we cannot guarantee that any of our menu items are free of allergens because we use shared equipment and handle common allergens throughout our supply chain and bakery-cafe. To learn more about nutrition for our Panera At Home™ consumer packaged products, please see the detailed ingredient listing on the applicable packaging or the Panera At Home pages on PaneraBread.com.

# Nutrition

### WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

At Au Bon Pain, we believe eating well is very important. What you eat should be nutritious AND delicious...which is why we are working to provide the right balance for you. Whether you want healthful dishes, refreshing drinks, nutrition packed snacks, complete meals, or from time to time, an indulgent treat, you can be sure your choice is flavorful and of the highest quality. To ensure smart, healthful, nutritious and innovative menu offerings and ingredients, we have assembled an expert culinary team experienced in quality and nutrition.

Making smart choices doesn't have to be hard. You'll find full nutrition profiles for every menu item and suggestions for high fiber, gluten-free and reduced sodium selections on our nutrition kiosks in cafes.

 

The nutritional information is based on Au Bon Pain's standard recipes and individual items may differ depending on a number of variables including variations in size and portioning that are inevitable when items are made by hand. Other factors that may cause actual nutritional values to differ include variations in serving sizes, preparation techniques, ingredient substitutions and changes in supply sources. Because of this we can't guarantee the nutrition content is precisely accurate. We base the values we publish on information provided to us by our suppliers and our own analysis using industry standard software, published resources and/or testing.

## Portion Size Control

#### ...The secret behind great health...

Food and health are inseparably connected, and it is only natural for many people to try to eat healthy and control amount of the food they eat. The quality and quantity of food should provide necessary nutrients and energy needs that correspond to age, gender, energy needs, and lifestyle to each individual.
For children who are still growing, the food should contained balanced nutrients that would help them grow as well providing enough energy for their active physical activities. Example of these foods are rice, egg, milk, bean, meat, fruits and vegetable.
As for adults, although their body no longer needs to allocate much of the energy to support rapid growth in physical and mental development that characterizes the early childhood to adolescence, but good nutrition is still very important. Good nutrition is essential for body's regeneration and repair, and adults should consume food that contains vital nutrition and at the same time provides enough energy for daily needs.

# Nutrition

## Food Allergy Facts

Does Bahama Breeze have procedures in place to minimize cross-contact in the kitchen?
    The restaurant is not an allergen-free environment. Bahama Breeze makes every effort to provide complete and current content information; however, due to the handcrafted nature of our menu items and variations in vendor supplied ingredients, we cannot make a guarantee regarding the allergen content of any menu item. Guests with a special food sensitivity or dietary need should not rely solely on this information as the basis for deciding whether to consume a particular menu item and are individually responsible for ensuring that any such menu item meets their individual dietary requirements.

What kind of oil is used in the fryer?
    We use highly refined soy oil in our fryers. Based on information from our suppliers, this oil is highly refined and does not contain the soy allergen.

Why don’t we provide information on allergens other than the "Big 9"?
    The FDA regulates allergen labeling for the ''big 9'' (milk, eggs, peanuts, tree nuts, fish, shellfish, soy, wheat, and sesame), so we can source this information from our suppliers. Because we recognize that our guests may be allergic to other ingredients, we are working to collect more allergen information from our suppliers. If you need information regarding allergies beyond the “big 9” please contact guest relations.

### BERTUCCI’S MENU NUTRITIONAL INFORMATION

### ARE BERTUCCI’S MEATBALLS BEEF? ARE BERTUCCI’S MEATBALLS GLUTEN-FREE?+

Bertucci’s meatballs are made from scratch daily with a blend of ground beef and ground sausage, with Italian ciabatta bread crumbs, buttermilk, eggs, onions, celery, Parmesan and Romano cheese and Italian herbs. Bertucci’s meatballs are not gluten-free or dairy-free.

Freshly prepared meatballs are served as a starter topped with house-made pomodoro & whipped ricotta. They are also the star of our Spaghetti & Meatballs pasta dish and a savory topping on our Meatball & Ricotta pizza.

### ARE BERTUCCI’S ROLLS VEGAN?+

Yes! Bertucci’s famous freshly baked rolls and pizza dough are vegan friendly. We do not use any butter, shortening or animal by-products in our scratch made dough. Looking for a Bertucci’s vegan pizza? Our handcrafted tomato sauce topped with our brick-oven roasted vegetables is what Chef Rosario calls “vegan heaven.”

# Nutritional Information

## Biaggi’s Nutritional Information

Our culinary teams in all Biaggi’s locations are passionately committed to providing you with an exceptional dining experience and will work to accommodate nutritional or dietary needs whenever possible. Our scratch kitchen provides more opportunities to add or withhold ingredients, change the manner of cooking and substitute side dishes and sauces.

We invite you to discuss your nutritional or dietary needs with your server so that they can inform the culinary team who will, when possible, make the necessary modifications. We’re happy to provide assistance in determining modifications or substitutions to accommodate dietary needs, including dressings or sauces served on the side, reduced-fat dressing or substitute a side salad or steamed vegetables in place of potatoes or fries. Select one of our Italian restaurants in Colorado, Illinois, Iowa, Indiana, Nebraska, Minnesota, Wisconsin, or Ohio to view specific menus, hours, & contact information.

Also our Gluten-Free menu provides selections for a gluten-restricted diet so your dining choices don’t have to be limited. At Biaggi’s, we recognize the challenges of dietary restrictions and we’re happy to provide gluten-intolerant guests with a variety of options that are never lacking in flavor, made with the care & quality that you expect from Biaggi’s!

Monday March 16, 2020 - 16:48PM

To our valued friends and family, 

For 67 years, it has been our mission at Bill Miller Bar-B-Q to serve delicious, affordable, and high-quality food to families in South Texas, and it remains so today. Our guests and teammates are like family to us, and as members of the community, we are doing everything that is being recommended by the CDC in response to the COVID-19 virus. 

We will continue monitoring official guidance from the Centers for Disease Control (CDC) and the World Health Organization (WHO) and communicating regularly with our teammates. 

  * We've asked our teammates to stay home if not feeling well and are staying in constant contact so that we may take prompt and efficient action. We kindly ask that any guests who are ill wait until they’ve recovered before letting us serve them in person. 
  * Our teammates are conducting additional comprehensive disinfecting procedures in all parts of the restaurant to provide added peace of mind to those dining with us. 
  * We have modified our common guest touchpoints with extra precaution to ensure safety for our guests and teammates.

# Nutrition & Allergy Information

The information provided in our Nutrition & Allergen Guide is based on ingredient information provided by our suppliers. Because our food is prepared in shared kitchens, normal restaurant operations may involve shared preparation and cooking areas, equipment, utensils, and fryers. As a result, cross-contact with allergens may occur, and we cannot guarantee that any menu item is completely free of allergens.

Our restaurants handle ingredients that contain the nine major food allergens: milk, eggs, fish, Crustacean shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans, and sesame. Guests with food allergies, sensitivities, or other dietary concerns should review the Nutrition & Allergen Guide before ordering and speak with a manager or server at the restaurant.

 

A printed copy of our Nutrition & Allergen Guide is available upon request at the restaurant.  Click below to read the guide in your browser.

# Nutrition Information

about our ingredients

Amish-raised, antibiotic-free chicken. St. Louis–cut ribs, hand-painted with our own secret-recipe sauce. Cornbread baked fresh every morning. And, of course, every meat smoked on-site over local hickory wood. It takes a lot to craft the city’s best barbeque, but you’ve got to start with great ingredients (and we do).

The nutritional values we’ve listed are based on our standard recipes and preparation methods, as well as information provided by our suppliers. Values for individual products may vary due to small differences in serving size, preparation methods, adjustments from our suppliers, and substitutions. Due to these factors, we can’t guarantee complete accuracy of our nutrition information.

Everything at City Barbeque is prepared on-site. Teammates in our joints handle ingredients including common allergens (sesame, wheat, peanuts, soy, tree nuts, milk, eggs, fish, and shellfish), and our smokers and kitchens use shared equipment with all our fresh ingredients. We will always indicate when a menu item contains a certain allergen, but we can’t guarantee any of our menu items are completely allergen-free.

Feel free to bookmark this page and check back, as our recipes do change slightly from time to time. Please also note not every menu item is served at every location: You may see menu items referenced here that aren’t on the menu at your local City Barbeque joint.

# CRACKER BARREL NUTRITION

At Cracker Barrel our mission of Pleasing People includes serving high-quality homestyle meals plus giving you the information you need to make informed dining decisions. We invite you to view our nutrition and allergen guides below to learn more.
An Important Note to Our Guests
Whether you’re craving a traditional breakfast, fresh salad or homestyle favorite, we like to think there’s something for everyone at Cracker Barrel Old Country Store®. Knowing that some of our guests may have specific dietary needs, we’ve crafted a variety of dishes to make sure that everyone at the table can enjoy a delicious meal that’s right for them.
The information provided in this guide is based upon ingredient statements provided to us by our suppliers and highlights which menu items are prepared without allergen containing ingredients. Our normal kitchen operations involve shared preparation and cooking areas, including common fryer oil; therefore, cross-contact of all our menu items (including allergens and meat) is possible. Fried and Grilled items should NOT be consumed if you have a food allergy. We cannot guarantee that the menu items listed are completely free of allergens. Regarding gluten, menu items that do not contain gluten does not necessarily meet the definition of "gluten-free" for those who are highly sensitive. # Nutrition Information

about our ingredients

Amish-raised, antibiotic-free chicken. St. Louis–cut ribs, hand-painted with our own secret-recipe sauce. Cornbread baked fresh every morning. And, of course, every meat smoked on-site over local hickory wood. It takes a lot to craft the city’s best barbeque, but you’ve got to start with great ingredients (and we do).

The nutritional values we’ve listed are based on our standard recipes and preparation methods, as well as information provided by our suppliers. Values for individual products may vary due to small differences in serving size, preparation methods, adjustments from our suppliers, and substitutions. Due to these factors, we can’t guarantee complete accuracy of our nutrition information.

Everything at City Barbeque is prepared on-site. Teammates in our joints handle ingredients including common allergens (sesame, wheat, peanuts, soy, tree nuts, milk, eggs, fish, and shellfish), and our smokers and kitchens use shared equipment with all our fresh ingredients. We will always indicate when a menu item contains a certain allergen, but we can’t guarantee any of our menu items are completely allergen-free.

Feel free to bookmark this page and check back, as our recipes do change slightly from time to time. Please also note not every menu item is served at every location: You may see menu items referenced here that aren’t on the menu at your local City Barbeque joint.

#### Can I get Cold Brew or Frozen Coffee in Decaf?

Unfortunately, our Cold Brew and Frozen Coffee are not available in Decaf.

#### Should I store my coffee in the refrigerator or freezer?

We do not recommend keeping our coffee in the refrigerator or freezer. Coffee is similar to baking soda in the way it can absorb moisture and aromas. candidates.text:
citeturn135search1 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: 2 weeks ago; Elevation Burger’s mission is to change the world one burger at a time. ... The idea behind Elevation Burger came from necessity.

# Ingredients Matter

* * *

Elevation Burger’s mission is to change the world one burger at a time. As a premium organic burger chain, we’ve elevated standards with our commitment to sourcing the highest quality ingredients, inclusive of 100% grass-fed organic beef patties, fries cooked in heart-healthy olive oil, and cage-free chicken.

Image: Ingredients Matter Tag@2x.png

The idea behind Elevation Burger came from necessity. A family on a budget was looking for healthy, organic options for their fast food cravings. When they couldn’t find it, they bet on themselves to make a better burger, and made a business of it. To much success, we might add. We continue to bet on better burgers being better for business, and we’ll bet you’ve never had one quite as good. Our fast food practices are anything but standard, and we’ve elevated the bar substantially. Like sourcing environmentally sustainable beef, completely grass-fed, in each and every patty. Or using heart-healthy olive oil to fry our fries. Everything is made to order, fresh and accessible at a fair price. It’s an elevated dining experience we’re after, and one we’ve achieved through concentrated effort. We care about sustainability not only in our ingredients, but also in our restaurant design. We incorporate the use of energy efficient lighting alongside economical fixtures, appliances and equipment, and products made from sustainable materials where available.

This commitment to quality has served us well. We’ve grown to over 40 locations nationally and internationally, with plenty more to come. Welcome to the high life.

### Frequently Asked Questions About Nutrition and Allergen

### [Button: Does your cheese have animal rennet/is it vegetarian friendly?]

We use Kraft American cheese. The product we use does not contain any meat-based enzymes or rennet.


### [Button: Does your food contain corn syrup/HFCS?]

The products we offer that contain high-fructose corn syrup are:

* Cattleman’s® brand BBQ sauce
* Heinz® brand ketchup
* Mount Olive® brand relish and pickle chips
* Our mayonnaise condiment
* The mushroom topping that we use
* Our fountain beverages.

Our buns also contain corn derivatives.

If this is an issue for you, please order your burger or dog without the bun.

### [Button: Is Five Guys safe for people with tree nut allergies? ]

Peanuts are served in all Five Guys restaurants, but none of our menu items contain tree nuts. They are also not used in our cooking process in any way.

However, please remember that there is always a risk of cross-contamination in our locations. 
### [Button: What are the ingredients in your buns?]

Our bread is a proprietary recipe. Our buns contain the following ingredients:
* Water
* Salt
* Sugar
* Vegetable Shortening (Contains Soy)
* Milk
* Eggs
* Bleached Bread Flour
* Yeast
* Sesame Seeds

# FUZZy'S TaCo SHoP NutRitioN aND ALLeRGeN INfoRMatioN

Fuzzy’s Taco Shop is dedicated to delivering a delightful dining experience, offering transparency in our ingredients to empower guests to make informed choices. We proudly feature an array of delicious food options, crafted to satisfy every craving and bring smiles to the table.

### Fuzzy’s Taco Shop Food Allergy Listing

At Fuzzy’s Taco Shop, we provide allergen information for our guests with dietary restrictions and food allergies. Guests can review our allergen information and order knowing many delicious menu options exist at Fuzzy’s Taco Shop for everyone. As part of our commitment to you, we provide the most current allergen information available from our food suppliers on nine common allergenic foods.
These foods include: egg, fish, milk, peanuts, sesame, shellfish, soy, tree nuts, and wheat. In addition, we identify menu items with gluten-containing ingredients. Because we have multiple sources of allergens in our shared cooking and prep areas, including common fryer oil, we are unable to guarantee that any menu item can be completely free of allergens. In addition, we use highly refined soybean oil in our fryers, which the FDA exempts from being labeled an allergen. Due to the complexity of our ingredients, other allergenic foods may be present in a menu item, but not declared on this section or menu.

# nutrition

## Nutritional & Allergen Info

### NUTRITIONAL INFORMATION

The ingredient information listed on our menus is meant to provide a general estimate of the nutritional values associated with our menu items.

### ALLERGEN INFORMATION

We understand the challenges facing the community of people who struggle with food allergies or have to manage food and beverage sensitivities in their lives. We know how difficult it is to eat safely, especially when eating out. It is important that you are aware that milk, eggs, tree nuts, seafood, soy, wheat, sesame products, crustacean shellfish, fish, sulfites and other allergens are present in our restaurants. We ask that when placing your order, you alert your server and the manager on duty to your food or beverage allergy or sensitivity. The more information relating to your specific needs you can provide, the better we can attempt to protect you. We will then try our best to avoid any accidental cross-contact, but we do not have separate equipment dedicated for the preparation of allergen based food requests.

## ALLERGENS AND FOOD SENSITIVITIES STATEMENT

Our menu and processes are evolving, and our restaurants are busier than ever. Whilst we take care to minimise contact between ingredients in our kitchens, our cooking and serving areas are open and we are quick-paced for fast service. 

We have introduced dividers between ingredients such as cheese, meat and non-meat ingredients, including eggs, to minimize transfer to neighbouring ingredients; however, this does not eliminate all risk. 

We handle flour tortillas, corn chips and cheese with gloved hands, meaning there can be transfer of these ingredients to meals being prepared. Whilst we use separate utensils for all other ingredients, sometimes they come into contact with the meal being prepared. The nature of our ingredients such as beans, meat and shredded cheese, means there is a risk of drips or shreds directly onto food preparation surfaces or meals being prepared. 

Therefore, our menu items may contain gluten, wheat, milk and egg. Removing an ingredient may not eliminate its presence. Any ingredient in our kitchen may be present in menu items 

Where hot beverages are available, hot beverages served with any milk may contain milk, soy, almond and gluten.

# Where to Find Product Details and Nutrition Info at CBTL Malaysia

Whether you're counting calories, managing dietary restrictions, or simply curious about what goes into your favorite Vanilla Latte, knowing where to find product details and nutrition information is essential. At The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf (CBTL) Malaysia, transparency and customer wellness go hand in hand. Here’s how you can access the information you need.

## 1. MyCBTL Malaysia App

The MyCBTL app is your go-to source for product descriptions, customization options, and sometimes nutritional highlights.

### What You’ll Find:

  * Menu items with images and ingredient breakdowns
  * Customization options (milk alternatives, sugar levels, etc.)
  * Allergen alerts for select items

> Tip: Tap on any menu item to view its full details before placing your order.

## 2. CBTL Malaysia Website

Visit for a broader overview of the menu and product offerings.

### What’s Available:

  * Full menu listings
  * Seasonal specials
  * Descriptions of drinks and food items
  * Occasional nutrition facts for featured products

> Note: Nutrition info may not be available for every item online. For detailed breakdowns, contacting customer service is recommended.

## 3. In-Store Assistance

CBTL baristas and staff are trained to help with product inquiries.

### Ask About:

# Allergen Information

Food allergies should never get in the way of you having a delicious meal. Check out our nutrition calculator for more information on how to enjoy the goodness of Jason’s Deli without common allergens like peanuts, shellfish, gluten, MSG and more

NUTRITION & ALLERGEN TOOL

## Our approach to gluten-free.

Though we can’t guarantee that there will be no cross-contact/cross-contamination of gluten — Jason’s Deli is not a 100% gluten-free environment — we take special care to ensure that our gluten-sensitive products do not come in contact with gluten.

Here’s how we prepare items from our Gluten-Sensitive Menu:

  * Every Jason’s Deli has a special gluten-sensitive kit for preparing gluten-sensitive (GS) items.

Inside this kit, items are color coded (purple) to alert employees that the menu item coming down is a GS item.

  * Separate cutting board, toasting trays, spatulas, mayo and mustard packets, to-go boxes, gluten-free stickers and bread help avoid contamination.

  * Condiments, in addition to mayo or mustard, are applied using a squeeze bottle with product that is not already in use.

  * Each line employee washes hands and changes gloves when a GS item is coming down the line.

  * Sandwiches are prepared with gluten-free bread on parchment paper instead of the regula

Where can I find ingredient and nutritional information?

You can find ingredients lists and allergen information here. 

I have a major nut allergy. Is Jeni's safe for me?

We make every flavor in a kitchen that also produces products that contain milk, eggs, peanuts, tree nuts, soy, and wheat. But we follow good manufacturing processes and organize our production days to go from the least amount of allergens to most, and always wash, rinse, and sanitize equipment between each flavor.

How much alcohol is in flavors made with alcohol? Is a flavor with alcohol safe for my child to eat?

The alcohol in any of our flavors tops out at about 0.5% or less per volume, which is a miniscule, trace amount. The alcohol from any beer, wine, and spirit we use to make a flavor is not burned off during production. Alcohol lends a distinct flavor to several of our signature flavors, and especially in sorbets, it prevents ice crystals from forming, creating a smoother texture.

Date: Thu Jun 13 00:00:22 2019 UTC

Go inside: Jeni's Splendid Ice Creams now open in NoDa

Jeni's Splendid Ice Creams, a tasty ice cream chain with a super popular South End location, is now open in NoDa. Expect lines.

The exact address is 416 E. 36th St., Suite 400. It's near the light rail spot and in the same development as Wooden Robot's new location which will also open within the next week or so.
Jeni's Summer hours are 11 a.m. to 11 p.m. everyday.
Fun fact: Just like the "Confetti Hearts Wall" has become one of the most Instagrammed spots in our city, look for the new "Confetti Stripes Wall" next to Jeni's NoDa to also become Instagram famous. Both are done by artist Evelyn Henson. She's cool.
Grand opening event: On June 27, Jeni's will be offering FREE ice cream for all from 7 p.m. to close (they'll be closed the first part of that day to prepare for the rush). Additionally, the first 50 in line on grand opening night will get free swag. Details.
Background: Founded in 2002 in Columbus, Ohio, Jeni's is known for fun, interesting and often extremely unusual flavor combinations and smooth, rich ice cream with a buttercream base. Flavors include brown butter almond brittle, salted peanut butter, brambleberry crisp, cream puff, frosé, gooey buttercake and darkest chocolate.
Don't forget: Jeni's will also open a third Charlotte location later this summer at Park Road Shopping Center in the space formerly occupied by Va da Vie Gelato. It's an ice cream invasion.

Ask Us About Catering

## Our Story

It all began in 1985 in a reclaimed old pizza restaurant on Clairmont Avenue in Birmingham, AL. The formula was simple. Celebrate the heritage of revered bar-b-q masters, cut no corners on the menu, and serve the whole community like family.

That philosophy allowed us to create something special. An authentic bar-b-q restaurant with chefs and pitmasters. A nod to our past recipes, with eyes towards the future. Sit down dining on one hand, and a drive-through on the other. No freezers, no microwaves, and no shortcuts. 12-hour slow-smoked pork and beef, but served real fast. A celebration of Alabama, but a reverence for the bar-b-q tradition across the South.

It’s the kind of place that only happens when you don’t follow the crowd, but instead follow your heart, trust your gut, and simply do things the hard way. 

Today, Jim ‘N Nick’s has become an icon of the bar-b-q community. One bite and you’ll understand why, there’s only one Jim ‘N Nick’s.

#### Nutritionele informatie

Klik hier of op de afbeelding voor een vergroting van de nutrionele informatie

Belangrijke informatie: De allergeneninformatie in deze tabel is gebaseerd op de standaard productformulering. Sommige menu-onderdelen zijn mogelijk niet in alle restaurants verkrijgbaar of zijn tijdelijke aanbiedingen. De informatie in de tabel geeft informatie over allergenen die als onderdeel van de receptuur aanwezig zijn. Ook de mogelijk aanwezige allergenen die door kruisbesmetting kunnen meekomen in één van onze ingrediënten, zijn aangegeven. 

In onze restaurants bereiden wij de producten zelf. Daarbij nemen wij alle mogelijke voorzorgsmaatregelen om kruisbesmetting in onze keuken te voorkomen. Dit doen wij onder andere door het bereiden van kipproducten met en zonder melk en ei zoveel mogelijk te scheiden. De Veggie Tenders worden apart gebakken van de kipproducten, maar wel in dezelfde frituur als de frites. Wij kunnen op verzoek ingrediënten zoals saus en kaas, achterwege laten. 

Desondanks is kruisbesmetting met alle allergenen die wij verwerken, maar vooral de veel gebruikte allergenen gluten, ei en melk, niet altijd 100% te voorkomen. Als na het lezen van deze informatie er nog vragen zijn, neem dan gerust contact met ons op via contactformulier of bel 0203116811.

# Kona Grill Nutritional Information

## What's in your Kona Grill Meal?

At Kona Grill we serve more than modern american grill favorites or sushi. We are proud to offer over 60 lower calorie menu items. We can also cater your favorite dish to your needs, removing sauces, having the dressing on the side or deleting an item. Our servers and chefs are trained to accommodate your desires and can offer suggestions without sacrificing flavor. We want you to have the Kona Grill experience without compromising your dietary needs and goals.

## Made From Scratch

Not all ingredients are listed in the menu. Before placing your order, please contact the restaurant if a person in your party has a food allergy or other food sensitivities. Please be aware that kona grill is not a gluten-free environment. Our menu items are handcrafted in our kitchens, often times using shared equipment (including common fryers) and variations in vendor-supplied ingredients may occur.

Nutritional Information

Our top 6 Nutritional Information FAQs

### Nutritional Information

Nutritional Information

#### Can I enjoy Kona Grill and still eat mindfully

Yes — many of our menu options are suitable for balanced eating. Choosing lean proteins, swapping heavier sides, or asking for sauces on the side can help you keep things lighter.

#### Where can I find calorie counts for specific dishes

Our nutritional guides include exact calorie counts and key nutritional values for every menu item, including entrées, sushi, sides and drinks.

## Nutritional info

To review the nutritional information for our products, please browse our menu for the latest information about each item.

Ingredient Information

The only animal by-products used in our doughnuts are eggs (whites and yolks) and dairy products (including milk, butter, yogurt, whey, nonfat milk and nonfat whey). To get further information about our products, call us at 1-800-4KRISPY.

Are Krispy Kreme Doughnuts Kosher?

All of our doughnuts are ingredient Kosher. Our mix plant in Winston-Salem, NC where the mix is made is certified Kosher. In addition, some of our stores, but not all, have been certified Kosher. Please contact your local shop for the most up-to date information.

The nutritional information contained in our restaurants or on our website (logansroadhouse.com) was prepared by Nutritional Information Services (NIS ). The information listed on our menus and websites is meant to provide a general estimate of the nutritional values associated with our menu items. The estimated nutritional values for a menu item may vary from the testing results due to variations in: serving sizes; preparation techniques; ingredient recipes supplied by our vendors; both seasonal and regional differences in products supplied to us; supplier substitutions; and, supplier testing methods. Is allergen information available about alcoholic beverages?

No, at this time, we do not have allergen information available for our alcoholic drinks. Can I ask about ingredients in your dishes?

# Where can I find information about product nutrition and ingredients?

March 04, 2021

To quickly access McDonald's nutrition & ingredients information, select "More" on the bottom navigation bar, then select "Nutrition," and search for the desired food item within the categories provided. Once you locate the food item, select the product tile. You will find a short description of the product as well as a "Nutrition" tab and "Ingredient" tab. ## FAQ

### Nutrition

Q: Do you serve a gluten-free pizza?
A: Monical’s is constantly striving to meet the needs of all of our guests. Nearly all Monical’s Pizza locations serve gluten-free pizzas. Please call your local Monical’s restaurant to verify if they are participating.

Q: Do you have nutrition labeling information?
A: Yes. Information is available on your restaurants menu page in the form of a nutritional calculator or a downloadable pdf format.

### 

### Online Products/Merchandise

Q: Can I order pizza online?
A: Most of our restaurants offer online ordering. Please click on the location nearest you to see if online ordering is available at that location.

Q: Do you sell your French dressing?
A: Definitely! Our famous bottled Sweet & Tart dressing is part of our growing line of merchandise, and can be purchased in our restaurants or on our online store under the “Shop” tab.

Q: Can I have a frozen pizza shipped to me?
A: No. In order for us to ship our Oven-Ready (frozen) Pizzas, they have to be manufactured in a USDA-approved facility.

### The Food

* * *

Your French fries take spuds to a whole new level. How do you do it?

It's a 24-hour 6-step process. Yeah, it's kind of like therapy for potatoes. It's a grueling, tedious procedure that requires a bunch of washing, cutting, rinsing, agitating (the potatoes and us) and double-frying. Honestly, the whole thing is a fatiguing fry frenzy, and we wouldn't go through the trouble if we didn't like you so much…not to mention the fact it creates the best freakin' fries this side of the sun!

# Pappas Bar-B-Q nutrition: what's published, what isn't

Every other site that ranks for this query invents numbers. Pappas Bar-B-Q does not publish per-item calories, macros or an allergen matrix, and pretending otherwise is worse than useless if you are managing a medical condition. What Pappas does publish is a full gluten-free menu and a clear cross-contact warning. This page covers exactly that, plus how to reason about portions when the data does not exist.

By the pappas-bbqmenu.onl menu desk Last verified 2 August 2026 · Cross-checked against Pappas' published dietary policy · how we check prices

Pappas Bar-B-Q does not publish nutrition information. There is no per-item calorie chart, macro breakdown or allergen matrix from the company. Its published policy is that guests should tell staff about dietary restrictions so they can advise. What Pappas does publish is a full gluten-free menu mirroring the plates, rib platters, chicken combos, baked potatoes, salads and sides at identical prices — together with an explicit warning that these items are prepared in a shared work area that also handles wheat and gluten, so cross-contact is possible. Any site quoting precise calorie counts for a Pappas plate is estimating, not reporting.

## The short version

  * No official calorie data exists. Treat every number you see online, including ours, as an estimate.
  * The gluten-free menu is real and comprehensive — and priced identically to the regular menu,

# Nutrition & Allergy Information

The information provided in our Nutrition & Allergen Guide is based on ingredient information provided by our suppliers. Because our food is prepared in shared kitchens, normal restaurant operations may involve shared preparation and cooking areas, equipment, utensils, and fryers. As a result, cross-contact with allergens may occur, and we cannot guarantee that any menu item is completely free of allergens.

Our restaurants handle ingredients that contain the nine major food allergens: milk, eggs, fish, Crustacean shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans, and sesame. Guests with food allergies, sensitivities, or other dietary concerns should review the Nutrition & Allergen Guide before ordering and speak with a manager or server at the restaurant.

Apple juice, pineapple juice, and coconut water. Never high-fructose corn syrup.

Honey, dates, stevia. 0g added sugar in many of our smoothies.

Nonfat milk with no rBST/rBGH added hormones.

candidates.title: About TPM Guide — Independent Guide to Pluckers Wing Bar
candidates.text:
citeturn187search1 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: 3 weeks ago; TPM Guide is produced by a small independent editorial team that follows the Pluckers Wing Bar menu closely — tracking prices, cross-checking nutrition and allergen figures against Pluckers' official documentation, and writing the ordering guides you'll find across the site. ... Restaurant menus change, and prices vary by location. ... Nutrition and allergen information is provided for reference only — always verify with your server before ordering, especially with a food allergy.

## Sauce Is the Variable That Matters

On this menu, sauce changes the numbers more than the item does. Plain 5-piece wings carry 135 mg of sodium. The same wings sauced reach 2,512 mg — a swing of nearly 2,400 mg from a single choice at the counter.

The Buffalo sauces are the heaviest at 1,770 mg per ounce, with Chili Lime close behind at 1,560. At the other end, Garlic Sriracha carries none at all, Spicy Mandarin 177 mg and Cajun 235 mg. Dry beats wet on sodium here, with the butter rubs as the exception.

Ranges reflect the sauce choice you have not made yet. That is why we keep them.

## Where These Figures Come From

Nutrition is transcribed from the official Pluckers Nutritional Facts guide, March 2022 edition. That is the most recent edition Pluckers has published — there is no 2026 version, and any site claiming one is describing a document that does not exist.

Prices come from the official Pluckers menu, checked 1 August 2026. Allergens come from the 2024 allergen list. Pluckers states directly that its kitchens have cross-contamination and that it cannot guarantee any item is free of allergens.

Our full method, including the errors we found inside the official guide, is at methodology and corrections.

Portillo’s NUTRITION AND ALLERGEN INFORMATION

The nutritional and allergen information contained in our restaurants and on our website (www.portillos.com) were prepared by Nutritional Information Services (NIS). To create this information, we compiled ingredient lists, allergen listings, and nutritional data from our suppliers and distributors. We also conducted food tests using a nutrition analysis software program. The information contained here is intended to serve as a guide for personal use – it is not a guarantee. This is our best effort to inform our valued customers about the contents of our food.

About Our Nutritional Information: Our nutritional information is meant to provide an estimate of the nutritional values associated with our menu items. Actual nutritional values for any given menu item may vary from the values listed here due to variations in product preparation, serving sizes, the fact that our menu items may be customized, the season of the year, sources of supply, and/or ingredient substitutions by our suppliers and distributors. Therefore, we cannot guarantee that the nutritional information provided here or at our restaurant locations is completely accurate as it relates to every menu item. Please note that customization of your order may affect the accuracy and/or completeness of the nutritional information provided.

Portillo’s assumes no responsibility for errors in labeling or changes in the chemical or constituent composition of ingredients or prepared products use

# FUZZy'S TaCo SHoP NutRitioN aND ALLeRGeN INfoRMatioN

Fuzzy’s Taco Shop is dedicated to delivering a delightful dining experience, offering transparency in our ingredients to empower guests to make informed choices. We proudly feature an array of delicious food options, crafted to satisfy every craving and bring smiles to the table.

### Fuzzy’s Taco Shop Food Allergy Listing

At Fuzzy’s Taco Shop, we provide allergen information for our guests with dietary restrictions and food allergies. Guests can review our allergen information and order knowing many delicious menu options exist at Fuzzy’s Taco Shop for everyone. As part of our commitment to you, we provide the most current allergen information available from our food suppliers on nine common allergenic foods.
These foods include: egg, fish, milk, peanuts, sesame, shellfish, soy, tree nuts, and wheat. In addition, we identify menu items with gluten-containing ingredients. Because we have multiple sources of allergens in our shared cooking and prep areas, including common fryer oil, we are unable to guarantee that any menu item can be completely free of allergens. In addition, we use highly refined soybean oil in our fryers, which the FDA exempts from being labeled an allergen. Due to the complexity of our ingredients, other allergenic foods may be present in a menu item, but not declared on this section or menu.

# CRACKER BARREL NUTRITION

At Cracker Barrel our mission of Pleasing People includes serving high-quality homestyle meals plus giving you the information you need to make informed dining decisions. We invite you to view our nutrition and allergen guides below to learn more.
An Important Note to Our Guests
Whether you’re craving a traditional breakfast, fresh salad or homestyle favorite, we like to think there’s something for everyone at Cracker Barrel Old Country Store®. Knowing that some of our guests may have specific dietary needs, we’ve crafted a variety of dishes to make sure that everyone at the table can enjoy a delicious meal that’s right for them.
The information provided in this guide is based upon ingredient statements provided to us by our suppliers and highlights which menu items are prepared without allergen containing ingredients. Our normal kitchen operations involve shared preparation and cooking areas, including common fryer oil; therefore, cross-contact of all our menu items (including allergens and meat) is possible. Fried and Grilled items should NOT be consumed if you have a food allergy. We cannot guarantee that the menu items listed are completely free of allergens. Regarding gluten, menu items that do not contain gluten does not necessarily meet the definition of "gluten-free" for those who are highly sensitive. We recommend our guests with food allergies speak with the restaurant manager prior to placing an order

# FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

### Nutrition & Allergies

Soy Allergy

Unfortunately, many of our hot food items contain soy.
Based on your allergy, you should not consume our fries, cheese, Shack Sauce, or the ‘Shroom Burger.

For complete information on the items that contain soy, please reference our Allergen Information before ordering.

Oil

We use cholesterol-free, pure soybean oil in all our fryers.

Gluten-free

We’ll gladly accommodate a gluten-free diet at each Shake Shack upon request. Just ask the Shack team for assistance and they’ll be happy to help.
You can also reference our Allergen Information before ordering.
​
Here are a few gluten-free suggestions:
Any burger can be ordered with a lettuce wrap. Flat-top dogs can also be ordered with a lettuce wrap!
Avoid ordering our ‘Shroom Burger, Shack Stack, and Chicken Shack or Bites, as these items all contain gluten.
The oil in our fryers is filtered through the same equipment as our ‘Shroom Burgers and Chicken Shack, so while the fries themselves are GF, there’s a possibility for cross-contamination.
Frozen custard should be ordered without the cone, and make sure to check the ingredients of any seasonal shakes with a Team Member before ordering.
As for drinks, skip the beer, but any soft drink or glass of wine is fine!

Vegeterian or vegan

We have a few options for vegetarians and vegans!

Our ‘Shroom Burger is a great meatless option, featuring a crisp-fried portobello mushroom filled with melted Monterey Jack, Tilsiter and Colby topped with lettuce, tomatoes, and Shack Sauce.

The nutrition data is based on representative values from the USDA Nutrient Database for Standard Reference and information from ingredient and product suppliers.

NUTRITION VALUES ARE REASONABLE ESTIMATES ONLY. SHONEY'S DISCLAIMS ANY AND ALL WARRANTIES AND REPRESENTATIONS REGARDING THE ACCURACY OR RELIABILITY OF NUTRITION VALUES IN THE NUTRITION INFORMATION.

The actual nutrition values of menu and buffet items may vary significantly from the nutrition information provided due to the handcrafted nature of those items and/or due to seasonal influences on the ingredients. citeturn197search3 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: today; For nutrition information, please view our nutrition analysis available in PDF. ... ## How can I purchase or redeem a Shoney's gift card?

Shoney's gift cards can be purchased online through retailers like Amazon.

# Frequently Asked Questions

## What are your hours of operation?

While most locations have similar hours of operation, each location is different. Please visit our locations page to find your local Shoney's store details. You also may want to call the restaurant directly as this information may change.

## What items do you have on your fresh food bar and how much does it cost?

Our All-You-Care-To-Eat Fresh Food Bar is full of delicious favorites. Check out our nightly specials on our menu page. You also may want to call the restaurant directly as our franchisees may change their fresh food bars on a different schedule.

## Is nutritional information available for your menu items?

For nutrition information, please view our nutrition analysis available in PDF.

## I need food at our office party. Can you help?

Shoney's Catering offers a great menu for your various party needs. Visit our catering page for more information.

## Where can I find Shoney's nearest location

You can find the nearest Shoney's by entering your ZIP code or city and state on the Locations page.

## Does Shoney's offer breakfast all day?

No, Shoney's does not serve breakfast all day. Breakfast is typically served until 11:00 AM on weekdays and until 1:00 PM on weekends.

## Do you offer online ordering or delivery?

Yes, Shoney's offers online ordering for pickup or delivery. You can order directly through our Online Ordering page or via delivery platforms like DoorDash Grubhub.

# Nutritional & Allergen Info

Slim Chickens is committed to the communities we serve, and the health and safety of our guests.

For our guests with food allergies, we provide the most current allergen information available from our food suppliers on nine common allergens, to help in making informed food selections. If you have or suspect you may have a food allergy, it is your responsibility to inform your cashier.

We only use trans-fat-free soybean oil, and do not use peanut oil in our kitchen. Please be aware that in normal shared cooking and preparation areas, including common fryer oil, it is possible for food items to come in contact with other food products. For that reason, we cannot guarantee that any menu item can be completely allergen-free. If you have questions about any item on our menu, please see our manager.

MSG is a component of our Grilled Tender Seasoning, Ranch and Cayenne Ranch Dipping Sauces and Sandwich Spreads. All menu items can be ordered without sauces, spreads, and seasonings.

Questions? Concerns? Contact us.

Soy* = Soybean oil only.

Sesame+ = Some restaurants may serve buns that contain sesame. Please ask your local store for more details.

FOOD ALLERGY? All of our menu items are Crafted in the same kitchen, so please use your discretion when ordering if you have a food allergy. Items may contain milk, eggs, wheat, soybean, fish, shellfish, sesame, tree nuts and/or peanuts.

## 
Nutrition

Back to Frequently Asked Questions

  * ### Where can I find the nutrition facts for my order?

Right here. We want you to have full nutrition information for any item on our menu including calories, carbohydrates, fat, cholesterol, sodium, fiber and protein. And, check out our nutrition calculator to find out the nutritional breakdown of your customized order.

  * ### How can I enjoy balanced options at Taco Bell?

It’s easy. And, you don’t have to compromise on the flavor and value you love and expect from Taco Bell. For example, nearly 3/4 of our menu items are less than 500 calories. And for breakfast, over 3/4 of our menu is less than 600 calories. For those who are concerned about calorie or fat intake, you can customize your food “Fresco style” – which replaces cheese, nacho cheese sauce, mayo-based sauces and reduced-fat sour cream with tomatoes, at no additional cost. This can provide a 25 percent reduction in fat. Our Power Menu™ delivers on big flavor, with bowls packed with high-protein under 500 calories. Here is more nutritional information about the choices and options we offer. TCBY® is the original and most well-known frozen yogurt brand, leading the market in nutrition, taste and product quality. Serving communities nationwide for 45 years, TCBY® is a successful model that has fueled the growth of a thriving industry. TCBY, which currently has over 125 franchise locations worldwide, offers an extensive product line, with most yogurt flavors in varieties that are low in fat, nonfat, or no sugar added. TCBY® launched its unique frozen yogurt classification "Super FroYo" in 2011, which is still the most nutritious frozen yogurt product available in the market, as well as was the first brand to market Greek Frozen Yogurt. Also based in New York, NY, TCBY® has been a frozen yogurt innovator from the day its first shop opened in Little Rock, Arkansas in 1981.

# Nutrition

## Food Allergy Facts

Does Bahama Breeze have procedures in place to minimize cross-contact in the kitchen?
    The restaurant is not an allergen-free environment. Bahama Breeze makes every effort to provide complete and current content information; however, due to the handcrafted nature of our menu items and variations in vendor supplied ingredients, we cannot make a guarantee regarding the allergen content of any menu item. Guests with a special food sensitivity or dietary need should not rely solely on this information as the basis for deciding whether to consume a particular menu item and are individually responsible for ensuring that any such menu item meets their individual dietary requirements.

What kind of oil is used in the fryer?
    We use highly refined soy oil in our fryers. Based on information from our suppliers, this oil is highly refined and does not contain the soy allergen.

Why don’t we provide information on allergens other than the "Big 9"?
    The FDA regulates allergen labeling for the ''big 9'' (milk, eggs, peanuts, tree nuts, fish, shellfish, soy, wheat, and sesame), so we can source this information from our suppliers. Because we recognize that our guests may be allergic to other ingredients, we are working to collect more allergen information from our suppliers. If you need information regarding allergies beyond the “big 9” please contact guest relations.

# Nutrition Information

about our ingredients

Amish-raised, antibiotic-free chicken. St. Louis–cut ribs, hand-painted with our own secret-recipe sauce. Cornbread baked fresh every morning. And, of course, every meat smoked on-site over local hickory wood. It takes a lot to craft the city’s best barbeque, but you’ve got to start with great ingredients (and we do).

The nutritional values we’ve listed are based on our standard recipes and preparation methods, as well as information provided by our suppliers. Values for individual products may vary due to small differences in serving size, preparation methods, adjustments from our suppliers, and substitutions. Due to these factors, we can’t guarantee complete accuracy of our nutrition information.

Everything at City Barbeque is prepared on-site. Teammates in our joints handle ingredients including common allergens (sesame, wheat, peanuts, soy, tree nuts, milk, eggs, fish, and shellfish), and our smokers and kitchens use shared equipment with all our fresh ingredients. We will always indicate when a menu item contains a certain allergen, but we can’t guarantee any of our menu items are completely allergen-free.

Feel free to bookmark this page and check back, as our recipes do change slightly from time to time. Please also note not every menu item is served at every location: You may see menu items referenced here that aren’t on the menu at your local City Barbeque joint.

# DIETARY RESTRICTIONS

## GLUTEN SENSITIVE

While we offer a section of gluten sensitive menu items, Yard House is not a gluten free environment. Products containing gluten are prepared in our kitchens. See the Gluten Sensitive menu for menu item suggestions that can be modified for gluten sensitive guests. Please let your server know your preferences.

## VEGAN-FRIENDLY

Yard House offers a variety of vegan-friendly menu items, including Beyond Meat^{®} and gardein™ products. Yard House offers a variety of menu selections made with gardein™ that do not contain meat, fish, poultry, shellfish or product derived from these sources, but may contain dairy or eggs.

Please note that Yard House is not a vegan environment as we share cooking surfaces, equipment, and storage areas with both animal and non-animal food products. Although we will make every effort to meet your dietary needs we cannot guarantee that there will be no cross contact.

See the Vegan-Friendly menu for menu item suggestions that can be modified for vegan-friendly guests. Please let your server know your preferences.

## VEGETARIAN

Yard House offers many menu dishes, including Beyond Meat^{®} and gardein™ products. However, Yard House is not a vegetarian restaurant. Meat products are prepared in our kitchen and on our cooking surfaces. See the Vegetarian menu for menu item suggestions and please let your server know your preferences.
